columns.description: Stable id of this snapshot: commit prefix and fingerprint prefix.
columns.name: snapshot_id

columns.description: URL of the analysed repository.
columns.name: repo_url

columns.description: Commit SHA of the analysed checkout.
columns.name: commit_sha

columns.description: UTC time the map was built, ISO 8601 (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH when set).
columns.name: built_at

columns.description: Name and version of the builder that produced the rows.
columns.name: builder_version

columns.description: 16-hex SHA-256 digest over sorted 'path NUL file-sha256' lines of every analysed file.
columns.name: source_fingerprint

columns.description: Number of Python files analysed.
columns.name: file_count

columns.description: Number of Python files found but not analysed (excluded or unparseable).
columns.name: omitted_file_count

columns.description: JSON array of plain-language limits of the static analysis.
columns.name: known_limits

description: One row identifying the analysed source: repository, commit, content fingerprint, builder and its known limits.
name: snapshot

columns.description: Repository-relative path of the file, with forward slashes.
columns.name: file_id

columns.description: Dotted name of the package that contains the module; empty for a top-level module.
columns.name: package

columns.description: Dotted import name of the module (a package's __init__.py has the package's name).
columns.name: module

columns.description: True when the path or file name marks the file as a test (tests/ or test/ directory, test_*.py, *_test.py, conftest.py).
columns.name: is_test

columns.description: Number of lines in the file.
columns.name: line_count

columns.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes; used to detect stale certifications.
columns.name: sha256

columns.description: Verbatim description from the module docstring; empty when the file has none.
columns.name: description

columns.description: Where the description came from: heading_purpose, module_docstring or none.
columns.name: description_source

columns.description: True when the module docstring uses the fixed headings [PURPOSE], [INTERFACE], [FLOW], [DEPENDENCIES] or [CONSTRAINTS].
columns.name: has_fixed_headings

description: One row per analysed Python source file. Module and package descriptions are in files.description; a package description belongs to its __init__.py row.
name: files

columns.description: File whose module docstring holds the heading.
columns.name: file_id

columns.description: Heading name such as [PURPOSE], or an atom name such as Teleology or Fails.
columns.name: heading

columns.description: Verbatim text under the heading or after the atom.
columns.name: value

columns.description: Position of the heading within the file's docstring, from 1.
columns.name: ordinal

description: Optional fixed sections and contract atoms from module docstrings only. This table can be empty even when ordinary module and function docstrings exist. Function docstrings are in symbols.summary, not this table.
name: headings

columns.description: ID: file path, '::', qualified name; repeated qualified definitions append @L<definition-line>.
columns.name: symbol_id

columns.description: File that defines the symbol.
columns.name: file_id

columns.description: Bare name of the symbol.
columns.name: name

columns.description: Dotted name within the module, e.g. Class.method.
columns.name: qualname

columns.description: function, method or class.
columns.name: kind

columns.description: First line of the definition, decorators excluded.
columns.name: line_start

columns.description: Last line of the definition.
columns.name: line_end

columns.description: True when neither the name nor any enclosing class name starts with an underscore.
columns.name: is_public

columns.description: First paragraph (or Teleology atom) of this function, method or class docstring, with whitespace normalized; empty when absent. This is the function documentation, unlike optional module headings.
columns.name: summary

columns.description: docstring or none.
columns.name: summary_source

description: Functions, methods and classes, their definition locations and extracted docstring summaries. Use this table for function definitions and function docstring questions.
name: symbols

columns.description: Class whose statement names the base.
columns.name: class_symbol_id

columns.description: Position of the base in the class statement, from 1.
columns.name: ordinal

columns.description: Base expression as written, e.g. SQLDatabase, base.SQLDatabase or Generic[T].
columns.name: base_name

columns.description: Internal class the base resolves to by the same static rules as calls; null for external, builtin or unresolvable bases.
columns.name: base_symbol_id

description: Base classes named in each class statement, in order, with the internal class each one resolves to.
name: class_bases

columns.description: Stable id: file path, line, column and a sequence number (for a callback row, the position of the argument).
columns.name: call_id

columns.description: Symbol whose body contains the call.
columns.name: caller_symbol_id

columns.description: Internal callee symbol; set only for same_file, imported and method_on_self, null otherwise.
columns.name: callee_symbol_id

columns.description: Callee as written at the call site, e.g. self.save or pd.read_csv; for a callback row, the reference as written in the argument.
columns.name: callee_name

columns.description: Line of the call.
columns.name: line

columns.description: same_file, imported or method_on_self (internal callee found); builtin (a Python builtin such as len); external (rooted in a third-party or standard-library import, or a module-level name assigned from one, e.g. logger); dynamic_attribute (a method on an object whose type is not statically known, e.g. row.get); unresolved (anything else).
columns.name: resolution

columns.description: high or low: low for inherited methods, callback rows, dynamic_attribute and unresolved.
columns.name: confidence

columns.description: direct (the call site invokes the callee) or callback (an internal function or method passed as an argument, e.g. asyncio.to_thread(f, x), executor.submit(f) or Thread(target=f), which the receiving call is expected to invoke). Callback rows always carry a callee and low confidence.
columns.name: call_kind

description: Call edges inside functions, methods and class bodies, with how the callee was resolved. Direct call sites are all kept; those without an internal callee have a null callee and are classified as builtin, external, dynamic_attribute or unresolved. Callback rows record an internal function or method passed by reference as an argument to another call, e.g. asyncio.to_thread(f, x).
name: calls

columns.description: Stable id: file path, line and a sequence number.
columns.name: import_id

columns.description: File containing the import.
columns.name: file_id

columns.description: Internal file the import resolves to; null for external or unresolvable imports.
columns.name: imported_file_id

columns.description: Absolute dotted module name imported (relative imports resolved).
columns.name: module_name

columns.description: Line of the import statement.
columns.name: line

columns.description: True when the module belongs to the analysed repository.
columns.name: is_internal

description: Import statements, one row per imported name, with the internal file each resolves to.
name: imports

columns.description: Test file.
columns.name: test_file_id

columns.description: Non-test file the test is linked to.
columns.name: target_file_id

columns.description: imports_target (the test imports the file) or name_match (test_<name>.py matches <name>.py).
columns.name: reason

description: Static associations between a test file and a source file, inferred because the test imports the file or its name matches. They are not measured test execution or coverage.
name: test_links
